fact: Cabinet approved the National Informal Economy, Start-ups and Entrepreneurship Development Policy (NIESED) on 26 November 2024 and directed the trade ministry to implement it in full.
The same Cabinet decision of 26 November 2024 directed the trade ministry to finalise an Act to accompany the start-ups policy.
Cabinet authorised the ICT ministry to engage female founders as potential beneficiaries of a US$20 million venture capital fund for ICT small businesses; no investment is named.
The December 2023 draft of the NIESED policy proposes a National Risk Capital Facility, to complement the National Venture Capital Fund, to close the early-stage financing gap.
